crossRefs.note: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.
For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings…
to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then…
For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
“This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.
but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’
Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions
